description.value: Walmart Supercenter (Store 1106) in Williams Lake, serving the Cariboo region with a full grocery department alongside electronics, clothing, furniture, toys, and baby goods. As one of the largest retail stores in the area, it is a significant resupply point for touring cyclists passing through central British Columbia. The Supercenter format means a broad range of supplies are available under one roof.
